semanticChecks: Immunity protects against bacteria/viruses; healthy appearance never removes infection risk. Hand hygiene, clean/unclean separation and standard precautions stay necessary independent of sleep/food/diagnosis.

Balanced diet, moderate exercise/rest/sleep and mental condition discussed with overwork/excess exercise/sleep loss/persistent stress/age/conditions; laughter/warmth never promises immunity gain or no infection, replaces precautions or authorizes forced heating/burdensome activity.
Rest differs from sleep; circadian roughly daily rhythm, light/dark/daytime and individual history/health/habits retained. No age-only imposed sleep/wake times.
NREM shallow-to-deep stages and REM rapid eye movement/wake-like brain activity distinguished; REM is not wakefulness, dreams alone and appearance/picture never determine stage.

Age-related sleep changes preserve individual variability/noise/nocturia; impaired daily living never dismissed. Resident words/wake times/noise/light/daytime effects separated, differences told to explicit responsible-person recipient; no worker sleep-drug selection/disease/stage diagnosis.

Aging variability retains lifestyle/health/era/environment and all five life stages, not fixed capacity; loss of ability/spouse/friend/role may relate to anxiety/loss/powerlessness/depressive mood, never all older adults same.

Sensory, strength/falls, taste/chewing/swallowing, bowel/renal/urinary, respiratory/infection resistance and vascular/BP changes compared to actual person and baseline; no age-only shouting/substituting without preference.

Multiple/chronic/comorbid disease and atypical symptoms retained; no fever does not establish appetite loss is aging. Team reviews treatment/medicine and whole information; dehydration/fever/constipation/edema/insomnia/inactivity loss/pressure injury each require assessment rather than neglect.

Dehydration balances intake and urine/sweat losses with diarrhea/vomiting/fever/sweat; dry lips/mouth/skin and urinary frequency/volume observed. Pulse/BP/temperature are actual measurements, not invented numbers or severity from appearance.
No thirst complaint still requires intake/excretion/health review. Heat and before/after exercise/bathing retain room temperature/drinking opportunities according to plan.

Cardiac/renal fluid restriction and swallowing problem forbid worker-only increase of drinking amount/method. Dry mouth/low urine reported for evaluation; explicit medical-staff-confirmed individual plan followed; no universal replacement volume. Severe dehydration may threaten life/require medical facility; actual change/urgency/facility help and no reporting delay for absent thirst preserved.

Hypothalamic temperature regulation, fever versus baseline and possible infection/inflammation/dehydration retained; red face/fatigue/appetite symptoms need not all occur. Actual measured temperature plus baseline/context reported.

Constipation retains frequency/hardness/difficulty/incomplete feeling and baseline form/interval/distress;24–72hours transit is reference, never universal24hour diagnostic criterion. New pain/nausea/appetite loss may have other cause and are reported.

Fiber/activity/postmeal opportunities individualized; swallowing/restriction/fever-specific fluid method retained, no forced common diet/time. Abdomen right/left belongs to resident; arrow is positional aid, not pressing force/count procedure. No independent medicine/abdominal procedure.

Persistent abdominal pain/vomiting/bloody stool with bowel problem leads promptly to explicit medical staff without waiting days; condition/plan/facility procedure and no diagnostic/treatment instruction retained.

Edema tissue fluid with cardiac/renal/nutritional/leg weakness/prolonged sitting possibilities and weight change, not diagnosis; site/side/degree/baseline and plan weight info reported. Hemiparetic affected-side edema does not explain all unilateral swelling.
Exercise/leg elevation only fits individual condition/plan, never universal edema cure. Pain/new change/unknown method checked with explicit responsible-person recipient.

Itch dryness/temperature/humidity/fabric and other causes including infection retained. Redness/rash/extent/degree/onset observed, scratching/color alone never proves allergy. Resident words and skin facts separated, appropriate products/plan, abnormality collaboration with explicit medical staff, no unconfirmed cause/independent drug/new procedure.

Insomnia separates sleep onset/interruption/unrested feeling plus onset/repetition/daytime sleepiness/activity; irritability/fatigue/environment/pain/elimination and resident corridor-bell words/time retained. No age-only invented cause or universal nap prohibition; individualized routine/daylight/activity/rest/night environment and medical evaluation if daily life impaired.
